Beyond the course list

  • Minimum overall GPA Maintain at least a 2.0 overall GPA and satisfy composition, business-core and area-of-study grade requirements.

TESU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 105 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 15 semester credits must be completed at TESU.
  • At least 18 semester credits must be upper-level.
  • TESU caps alternative credit at 90 semester credits.

Source: TESU current standard, military and foreign-credit residency policies · TESU current BSBA Finance degree requirements · TESU combined noncollegiate credit limit · TESU current transfer limits, required university courses and grades · TESU BS/BSBA upper-level, course currency and elective policies

Questions

Does Study.com Business 308: Globalization & International Management transfer to Thomas Edison State University?

Study.com publishes this match: Study.com Business 308: Globalization & International Management for MAN-3720 International Management (3 semester credits). The match does not come from TESU, so ask TESU to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Business 306: Strategic Human Resource Management transfer to Thomas Edison State University?

Study.com publishes this match: Study.com Business 306: Strategic Human Resource Management for Free elective 3 (3 semester credits). The match does not come from TESU, so ask TESU to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Thomas Edison State University’s B.S.B.A. in Finance?

TESU’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 105 semester credits from other sources. At least 15 semester credits must be completed at TESU. This plan proposes 87 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Thomas Edison State University?

In this plan, 33 semester credits are taken at TESU, including SOS-1100 Fact, Fiction, or Fake? Information Literacy Today and BUS-4210 Business Administration Capstone. TESU requires at least 15 semester credits at TESU.

Has Thomas Edison State University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need TESU’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school to confirm 13 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Check the provider’s current enrollment terms for 16 outside courses before you enroll. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always TESU’s decisions.
